newsitem.title: INDIA: India metals bounce back, industrial buyers active.
newsitem.headline: India metals bounce back, industrial buyers active.

text.p: Indian base metals bounced back on Tuesday from reduced levels as industrial buyers turned active and imports fell, dealers said.
Reports of a recovery in the world market also prompted fresh speculative interest. Ready copper rose by 50 rupees to 12,450 rupees per quintal while zinc rose by the same margin at 6,500 rupees.

Tin gained by 100 rupees to 34,400 rupees per quintal while nickel rose by 300 rupees to 36,500 rupees. Nickel was down by 300 rupees during last week. Aluminium was unchanged at 7,200 rupees and lead at 4,400 rupees.
